pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.2: tena kho pana samayena ariṭṭhassa nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.3: “tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti”.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.5: “ariṭṭhassa kira nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.6: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.7: atha kho te bhikkhū yena ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.9: “saccaṃ kira te āvuso ariṭṭha, evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ,–
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.10: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.11: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi “yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.12: mā āvuso ariṭṭha, evaṃ avaca. mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi. na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ. na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.13: anekapariyāyena āvuso ariṭṭha, antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.14: appassādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.15: aṭṭhikaṅkhalūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.24: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.25: evampi kho ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tehi bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva taṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.26: “evaṃ vyākho ahaṃ āvuso, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.27: yato ca kho te bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ. atha kho te bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.28: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ paṭipucchi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.29: saccaṃ kira te ariṭṭha evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.30: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.31: evaṃ vyākho ahaṃ bhante, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.32: kassa nu kho nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa, mayā evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.33: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā, alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.34: appassādā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.44: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.45: atha ca pana tvaṃ moghapurisa, attanā duggahitena amhe ceva abbhācikkhasi, attānañca khaṇasi, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.46: taṃ hi te moghapurisa, bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.48: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.50: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.52: mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, nahi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, nahi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.53: anekapariyāyena āvuso, antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.54: evañca pana so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.55: yāvatatiyaṃ ce samanubhāsiyamāno tampaṭinissajjeyya iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.6: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.10: aññehi bhikkhūhi; ye passanti ye suṇanti tehi vattabbo
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.11: mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ nahi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.12: anekapariyāyena āvuso antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.19: mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.20: anekapariyāyena āvuso antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā. alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.29: itthannāmassa bhikkhuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.30: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.32: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāseyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.36: itthannāmassa bhikkhuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.37: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.39: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāsati tassā diṭṭhiyā paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.40: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno samanubhāsanā tassā diṭṭhiyā paṭinissaggāya, so tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.45: itthannāmassa bhikkhuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.46: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.48: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāsati tassā diṭṭhiyā paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.49: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno samanubhāsanā tassā diṭṭhiyā paṭinissaggāya so tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.51: samanubhaṭṭho saṅghena itthannāmo bhikkhu tassā diṭṭhiyā paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.52: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
